summary: Implemented one deterministic fixture-only command that runs the offline live-shaped snapshot adapter through the existing raw intake, scoring, review table, paper order plan, paper execution ledger, and portfolio exposure summary. The command preserves adapter rejections and raw/intake rejections with reasons and emits JSON by default or Markdown with --markdown.
limitations: Fixture-only lifecycle; no live fetcher, network call, external API call, or live market integration is implemented.
Current price, volatility, momentum, execution prices, fills, settlement, exposure, and PnL are deterministic fixture fields/calculations only.
The command reuses existing offline paper lifecycle modules and does not add runtime wiring, dispatcher/run_codex changes, prompt automation, broad refactors, or a new validation layer.
No credentials, wallet/private-key access, real orders, real-money execution, or live trading path was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-017: add a narrow regression gate for the live-shaped snapshot-to-paper lifecycle command so future changes lock this new offline demo path.
